    Wait! If the answer is "Gossip", why would the clue-giver say "Yes: Gossip"?
    In Concept, if you guess the exact word, the clue-giver says "Correct".
    If you guess something *close* to the word, the clue-giver says "Yes: [your guess]".
    So the answer is *not* "Gossip". It is something *like* gossip, or a phrase containing "gossip".
